courses.title: Course 3
courses.description: Accelerated middle-school mathematics focused on real numbers, linear relationships, functions, geometry, and bivariate data.

units.title: Rigid Transformations and Congruence
units.description: Start the Amplify Grade 8 sequence by sliding, flipping, and turning figures while preserving distance, angle measure, and shape.

concepts.title: Translations on the Coordinate Plane
concepts.description: Use horizontal and vertical moves to translate points and figures, write coordinate rules, and reason from image back to preimage.

concepts.title: Reflections on the Coordinate Plane
concepts.description: Reflect points and figures across the x-axis, y-axis, and origin while reasoning about image, preimage, and preserved distance.

concepts.title: Rotations on the Coordinate Plane
concepts.description: Rotate points and figures around the origin using 90-degree clockwise, 90-degree counterclockwise, and 180-degree coordinate rules.

concepts.title: Sequences of Rigid Transformations
concepts.description: Apply ordered sequences of translations, reflections, and rotations while tracking intermediate images and preserving congruence.

concepts.title: Congruent Figures on a Grid
concepts.description: Identify congruent grid figures by matching corresponding side lengths, angle measures, and rigid-motion evidence.

concepts.title: Congruence from Transformation Sequences
concepts.description: Use sequences of translations, reflections, and rotations as evidence that figures are congruent.

concepts.title: Parallel Lines and Transversals
concepts.description: Use angle relationships formed by parallel lines and transversals to identify equal and supplementary angles.

concepts.title: Triangle Angle Relationships
concepts.description: Use the triangle angle sum, special triangle relationships, and algebraic angle expressions to find missing angles and classify triangles.

concepts.title: Exterior Angles of Triangles
concepts.description: Use exterior angle relationships, remote interior angles, and linear pairs to solve for missing triangle angles.

concepts.title: Unit 1 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Review rigid transformations, congruence evidence, parallel-line angle relationships, triangle angle sums, and exterior angles.

units.title: Dilations, Similarity, and Slope
units.description: Build the Amplify Unit 2 foundation by resizing figures with dilations, reasoning about scale factor and similarity, and connecting similar triangles to slope.

concepts.title: Dilations on the Coordinate Plane
concepts.description: Dilate points and figures from the origin, identify scale factors, and reason about enlargement, reduction, side lengths, and area change.

concepts.title: Scale Factor and Dilations
concepts.description: Use scale factor to compare original and image lengths, find missing measures, and reason about length, perimeter, area, and coordinate effects.

concepts.title: Similar Figures
concepts.description: Identify similar figures using corresponding angles and proportional side lengths, then use scale factor to find missing measures and compare perimeter and area.

concepts.title: Missing Side Lengths in Similar Triangles
concepts.description: Use corresponding sides, scale factors, and proportions to find missing side lengths in similar triangles and real-world shadow problems.

concepts.title: Angle-Angle Similarity
concepts.description: Prove triangles are similar using two matching angle pairs, triangle angle sums, parallel-line angle relationships, and correct vertex correspondence.

concepts.title: Similar Triangles and Constant Slope
concepts.description: Use similar slope triangles to explain why a line has a constant slope.

concepts.title: Understand Slope as Rate of Change
concepts.description: Interpret slope as a constant rate of change in tables, graphs, equations, and contexts.

concepts.title: Find Slope from Graphs
concepts.description: Find slope on coordinate graphs by using rise over run between two points on a line.

concepts.title: Unit 2 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Review dilations, scale factor, similar figures, similar triangles, AA similarity, constant slope, rate of change, and finding slope from graphs.

units.title: Proportional and Linear Relationships
units.description: Write and compare proportional and linear relationships using tables, graphs, equations, slope, and y-intercepts.

concepts.title: Proportional Relationships as Lines
concepts.description: Connect proportional relationships to lines through the origin and equations of the form y = mx.

concepts.title: Equations in the Form y = mx
concepts.description: Write and interpret proportional linear equations in the form y = mx.

concepts.title: Understand the y-Intercept
concepts.description: Interpret the y-intercept as the starting value and the point where a line crosses the y-axis.

concepts.title: Equations in the Form y = mx + b
concepts.description: Write and interpret linear equations using slope and y-intercept.

concepts.title: Find Slope from Tables and Points
concepts.description: Calculate slope from tables and coordinate pairs using change in y over change in x.

concepts.title: Compare Rates of Change
concepts.description: Compare rates of change across proportional relationships, tables, graphs, and contexts.

concepts.title: Graph Linear Equations
concepts.description: Graph lines by plotting the y-intercept and using slope as rise over run.

concepts.title: Write Linear Equations from Representations
concepts.description: Write y = mx + b equations from tables, points, graphs, and contexts.

concepts.title: Unit 3 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Review slope, y-intercept, linear equations, graphing, and multiple representations of lines.

units.title: Linear Equations and Linear Systems
units.description: Solve, model, and explain one-variable equations and systems, including a linear-equations checkpoint and a full unit review.

concepts.title: Review Equivalent Expressions
concepts.description: Review combining like terms, distribution, factoring, and equivalent-expression reasoning before solving linear equations.

concepts.title: Solve Multi-Step Equations
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations that require simplifying, inverse operations, negative coefficients, fractions, decimals, and solution checks.

concepts.title: Equations with the Distributive Property
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations that require distributing, handling negative factors, combining like terms, and checking in the original equation.

concepts.title: Equations with Variables on Both Sides
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations by moving variable terms, moving constants, distributing when needed, and checking solutions.

concepts.title: Equations with Rational Coefficients
concepts.description: Solve one-variable equations with fraction and decimal coefficients by clearing denominators, combining terms, and checking solutions.

concepts.title: One Solution, No Solution, or Infinitely Many Solutions
concepts.description: Classify linear equations by simplifying both sides and comparing variable terms and constants.

concepts.title: Build Equations from Context
concepts.description: Translate situations into one-variable equations by identifying constants, rates, variables, and equal quantities.

concepts.title: Linear Equation Word Problems
concepts.description: Solve one-variable linear equation word problems by defining a variable, building an equation, solving, and interpreting the answer.

concepts.title: Check and Explain Equation Solutions
concepts.description: Check proposed solutions in original equations and explain whether solving steps preserve equality.

concepts.title: Linear Equations Checkpoint
concepts.description: Review equivalent expressions, multi-step equations, distributive property equations, rational coefficients, solution types, modeling, and checking solutions.

concepts.title: Understand Solutions to Systems
concepts.description: Understand a system solution as an ordered pair that makes both equations true.

concepts.title: Solve Systems by Graphing
concepts.description: Solve systems by graphing both lines and identifying their intersection point.

concepts.title: Solve Systems by Substitution
concepts.description: Solve systems algebraically by replacing one variable with an equivalent expression.

concepts.title: Solve Systems by Elimination
concepts.description: Solve systems by adding or subtracting equivalent equations to eliminate one variable.

concepts.title: Systems with No Solution
concepts.description: Recognize systems whose lines are parallel and therefore have no ordered-pair solution.

concepts.title: Systems with Infinitely Many Solutions
concepts.description: Reason about systems with infinitely many solutions through worked examples, varied practice, and transfer problems.

concepts.title: Choose an Efficient System-Solving Method
concepts.description: Reason about choose an efficient system-solving method through worked examples, varied practice, and transfer problems.

concepts.title: Systems of Equations Word Problems
concepts.description: Reason about systems of equations word problems through worked examples, varied practice, and transfer problems.

concepts.title: Unit 4 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Reason about unit 4 mixed review through worked examples, varied practice, and transfer problems.

units.title: Functions and Volume
units.description: Connect function rules and representations before applying relationships to volume.

concepts.title: Understand Functions
concepts.description: Distinguish inputs and outputs and explain when an assignment defines a function.

concepts.title: Functions in Tables and Mapping Diagrams
concepts.description: Interpret, compare, and repair tables and mapping diagrams using unique outputs.

units.title: Real Numbers and Exponents
units.description: Build a strong foundation with rational and irrational numbers before moving into radicals, exponents, and scientific notation.

concepts.title: Rational and Irrational Numbers
concepts.description: Classify real numbers by recognizing fractions, terminating and repeating decimals, square roots, and nonrepeating decimals.

concepts.title: Repeating Decimals as Fractions
concepts.description: Use place value and algebra to convert repeating decimals into exact fractions and explain why the method works.

concepts.title: Square Roots and Perfect Squares
concepts.description: Recognize perfect squares, evaluate principal square roots, and connect square roots with equations and square area.

concepts.title: Cube Roots and Perfect Cubes
concepts.description: Recognize perfect cubes, evaluate positive and negative cube roots, and connect cube roots with equations and volume.

concepts.title: Approximate Irrational Numbers
concepts.description: Locate irrational numbers between rational benchmarks, approximate them to a requested precision, and compare or apply their values.

concepts.title: Compare and Order Real Numbers
concepts.description: Compare and order rational and irrational values using exact simplification, benchmarks, approximations, and number-line reasoning.

concepts.title: Integer Exponents
concepts.description: Interpret powers and use positive-integer exponent laws to simplify numerical and algebraic expressions with clear reasoning.

concepts.title: Zero and Negative Exponents
concepts.description: Extend exponent rules to zero and negative exponents, rewrite expressions with positive exponents, and explain reciprocal reasoning.

concepts.title: Powers of Ten
concepts.description: Use powers of ten to represent, compare, and scale large and small quantities by reasoning about place value.

concepts.title: Scientific Notation
concepts.description: Write, interpret, compare, and convert very large and very small quantities using scientific notation.

concepts.title: Operations with Scientific Notation
concepts.description: Multiply, divide, add, subtract, estimate, and interpret quantities written in scientific notation.

concepts.title: Unit 1 Mixed Review
concepts.description: Review real numbers, radicals, exponent rules, powers of ten, and scientific notation across the full Unit 1 progression.
